event: Ticking sound from the gas stove igniter.

sounding_object.description: A stainless steel gas stove cooktop with black grates and multiple black control knobs. The ticking sound originates from its electronic igniter. It is a built-in kitchen appliance.

reference_object.description: A white, stylized rabbit-like sculpture, approximately 20-30cm tall, located on the wooden coffee table in the living room.

facing_object.description: A modern, light-gray fabric three-seater couch located in the living room.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the black decorative animal sculpture and facing the light-gray three-seater couch, when the ticking sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
